school_name: The Children's Courtyard on West Lamar Blvd
welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to The Children's Courtyard in Lamar, Arlington, TX. We are new and improved from remodeling to new Leadership. Where we are dedicated to provided the best childcare experience for you and your children. Our Infant Care, Preschool and Pre-Kindergarten programs provide the perfect foundation for learning and child development. I'm proud to say our school is nationally accredited Cognia Accreditation. I lead a great group of teachers who are always smiling and truly love what they do. Together, they have over 25 years of combined experience in child care. They receive monthly training and participate in ongoing training offered by the state. We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. Our facility opened in 1989 and is state-of-the-art; I know you will love it! I encourage you to come in for a tour and learn about everything The Children's Courtyard in Arlington, TX, can offer your family. We are located on the corner of Lamar Blvd. and Davis Street. We service elementary schools: Butler Elementary, Peach Elementary, Jones Academy, Wimbish World Language Elementary, Pope Elementary, Webb Elementary, Uplift Summit International Academy, Sherrod Elementary.

Daycare and Early Education Programs Infants 6 weeks – 1 year old We provide an exceptional, comfortable, safe space for your little one to grow and thrive. Toddlers 1 - 2 years old Learning is doing, so little ones have all the space they need to move, explore, and excel. Twos 2 – 2.5 years old Learners on the move! Embrace and discover energetic, active learning experiences. Early Preschool 2.5 – 3 years old Get ready for Preschool, while growing, developing confidence, and gaining independence. Preschool 3 – 4 years old For active little achievers, hands-on learning experiences help children prepare for kindergarten. Pre-K 4 – 5 years old Gain a strong foundation for kindergarten, while laying the groundwork for advanced skill development. Before & After School The perfect mix of education and recreation offers a positive start and finish to every school day. Summer Camp Our full-day program inspires curiosity and wonder through thoughtfully designed weekly themes. Here's what people have to say We're proud to be accredited by Cognia! Open a window to your child's day. SproutAbout ® , our exclusive family app, provides free live streaming video of your child's classroom to your mobile device. Electives Offered Elective programs allow students to learn by exploring creative outlets that will help them advance in the future—while giving your family more free time on evenings and weekends. We offer: Dance, Fitness, Handwriting & Advanced Math, Music, Phonics, Soccer, Spanish, Yoga Meet Our Staff ShaCasual Dunn, Assistant Director Certifications : First Aid/CPR/ Food Handler My name is ShaCasual, and I bring more than 11 years of experience in early childhood education, including 10 years with Children's Courtyard. I began as an assistant teacher, became a lead teacher, and later served as an Administrative Assistant. In April, I stepped into the role of Assistant Director, where I work alongside the Director to support staff, families, and daily school operations. I am passionate about supporting children, families, and our school community. Nelda Jackson-Moses , Director Education : Elementary Education Degree Certifications : First Aid/CPR, Director's Permit, Food Manager's Certificate I bring more than 30 years of experience in early childhood education and hold a degree in Elementary Education. For over 15 years, I have served as a Center Director, building strong relationships with children and families while supporting each child's growth and development. I enjoy seeing the excitement that comes with new discoveries and take pride in creating a strong sense of community and lasting connections with families.
